A '''Aqualish''' of the [[Quara/Legends|Quara]] race served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, he defected from the Confederacy later and joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="MedStar II" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] served on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] and was wounded during the [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] raging on the world. They were brought to the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] where they were operated on by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]] [[Leemoth]].<ref name="MedStar II" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aqualish appeared in ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', the second novel of the [[MedStar Duology]]. ''Jedi Healer'' was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
